Name: MultiplayerHorseReskin - Continued
Author: TadeDM
Description: [center][size=5][b]Multiplayer Horse Reskin [/b][/size][i]Give each horse on your farm a unique look — fully synced in multiplayer![/i][/center][size=4][b]DESCRIPTION[/b][/size][b]Multiplayer Horse Reskin[/b] lets you assign custom skin textures to each horse on your farm. Works fully in multiplayer — all players see the same skins in real time!This is an updated version of the original mod by [b]DelphinWave[/b], now fully compatible with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4[/b].[size=4][b]FEATURES[/b][/size][list][*]Assign different skins to each horse on your farm[*]Fully synced in multiplayer — all players see the changes in real time[*]Simple in-game menu: stand inside the stable and press the action button[*]Supports up to 8 skins by default (configurable — add as many as you want)[*]Skins persist between sessions (saved when you sleep)[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][*]Tractor Mod compatible (ignores tractors)[*]Controller / gamepad support[/list][size=4][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/size][list][*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0.0[/url] or higher[*][b](Optional)[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/list][size=4][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size][b]1. Install the mod[/b][list=1][*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] if you haven't already[*]Unzip and copy the [b]MultiplayerHorseReskin[/b] folder into your Mods folder[*]Launch the game through SMAPI[/list][b]2. Add skin textures[/b]This mod does [b]not[/b] come with skin textures — you need to add your own .png files to the [b]assets[/b] folder:[code]Mods/MultiplayerHorseReskin/assets/horse_1.pngMods/MultiplayerHorseReskin/assets/horse_2.pngMods/MultiplayerHorseReskin/assets/horse_3.png...[/code]Files must be named [b]horse_1.png, horse_2.png[/b], etc. and be [b]128 x 192 px[/b] spritesheets (same format as the vanilla horse). You can use the original as a base:[code]Stardew Valley/Content/Animals/horse.png[/code]By default the mod looks for up to 8 skins. Change [b]AmountOfHorseSkins[/b] in config.json to use more or fewer.[size=4][b]HOW TO USE[/b][/size][list=1][*]Go to your farm and walk [b]inside[/b] the stable[*]Press the [b]action button[/b] (right-click or gamepad A)[*]Use the arrows to browse skins and press [b]OK[/b] to confirm[*][b]Sleep to save[/b] your selection[/list][size=4][b]MULTIPLAYER[/b][/size][list][*]The host must have the mod installed[*]Farmhands should also install it to see and change skins[*]Skins sync automatically when a player joins[/list][size=4][b]CHANGELOG[/b][/size][b]v1.2.0[/b] — SV 1.6 Update[list][*]Full compatibility with Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4[*]Fixed skin not applying until the next day[*]Fixed crash when opening the stable menu with no textures loaded[*]Updated Generic Mod Config Menu to new API[*]Relaxed multiplayer version check (no longer requires exact version match)[/list][b]v1.1.2[/b] — Original release by DelphinWave[size=4][b]CREDITS[/b][/size]Original mod created by [b]DelphinWave[/b]. Updated for SV 1.6 with permission from the original author.[center][i]If this mod helped you, please consider endorsing it![/i][/center]

Downloads.Description: 1.6 & Multiplayer update. New controls: hold Shift (keyboard) or LT/RT (controller) + Action on the stable to change skins. Normal click now allows you to mount the horse seamlessly without interruptions.
